name: fdsi-ai-security-arena
description: Laboratorio final FDSI: evaluación Red Team / Blue Team del asistente ficticio AURA (OWASP Top 10 LLM 2026) con Promptfoo y Ollama.

scripts.kit:baseline: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c kit/baseline.yaml --no-cache -o results/original_baseline.json results/original_baseline.html
scripts.kit:hardened: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c kit/hardened.yaml --no-cache -o results/original_hardened.json results/original_hardened.html
scripts.eval:original:r0: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c configs/original_fixed.yaml --filter-providers R0 --no-cache -o results/original_fixed_r0.json results/original_fixed_r0.html
scripts.eval:original:rs: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c configs/original_fixed.yaml --filter-providers RS --repeat 5 --no-cache -o results/original_fixed_rs.json results/original_fixed_rs.html
scripts.eval:compare:r0: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c configs/compare.yaml --filter-providers R0 --no-cache -o results/compare_r0.json results/compare_r0.html results/compare_r0.csv
scripts.eval:compare:rs: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c configs/compare.yaml --filter-providers RS --repeat 5 --no-cache -o results/compare_rs.json results/compare_rs.html results/compare_rs.csv
scripts.eval:guarded:r0: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c configs/guarded.yaml --filter-providers R0 --no-cache -o results/guarded_r0.json results/guarded_r0.html
scripts.eval:guarded: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c configs/guarded.yaml --filter-providers RS --repeat 5 --no-cache -o results/guarded_rs.json results/guarded_rs.html
scripts.eval:holdout: npx promptfoo@0.126.0 eval -c configs/holdout.yaml --repeat 5 --no-cache -o results/holdout.json results/holdout.html
